name: home-energy-home-assistant

scripts.check: node --check deploy.mjs && node --check scripts/control-home-assistant.mjs && node --check scripts/install-integration.mjs && node --check scripts/wait-for-home-assistant.mjs && node --check src/dashboard.mjs && node --check src/deployer.mjs && node --check src/discovery.mjs && node --check src/ha-client.mjs && node --check src/site-config.mjs && node --test

scripts.check:all: npm run check && npm run check:python
